title.zh: 字节、阿里、腾讯下单超300万张英伟达RTX PRO 5500显卡，订单总额超350亿美元
title.en: 字节、阿里、腾讯下单超300万张英伟达RTX PRO 5500显卡，订单总额超350亿美元

current_state.zh: ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent have ordered more than 3 million Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 workstation GPUs worth over $35 billion, but Nvidia reportedly cannot guarantee full delivery amid tight capacity and export-control-driven demand.
current_state.en: ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent have ordered more than 3 million Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 workstation GPUs worth over $35 billion, but Nvidia reportedly cannot guarantee full delivery amid tight capacity and export-control-driven demand.
